objective: Make player-facing System feedback feel immediate and actionable: push taps on rewards/achievements/success open a full-screen result view, while the focused quest on Status exposes the same canonical execution action as the Quest card.

roles_before.artifact: store-v2.mjs sends every notification to the generic Notifications tab.
sw-v2.js focuses/navigates the PWA to the payload URL on notification tap.
app-v2.js/player-utility.js render notification cards but no full-screen success presentation.
Status focus panel shows next objective/reward/timing but no execution action.
player-utility.js owns the current canonical Bebris lesson-2 execution action and injects it only into the expanded Quest card.
Neon/system_events owns Quest/progression/achievement/notification state; this slice must not mutate it.
Git and immutable System event history preserve pre-change behavior.

role_dispositions.destination: Deep-link pushes to the exact notification id; add celebrate=1 only for REWARD/ACHIEVEMENT/SUCCESS.
Keep the existing safe notificationclick navigation mechanism; only the payload target becomes more specific.
Add a full-viewport dialog that renders exact notification copy and optional Level/XP/Coin chips without fabricating values.
Add a focusActions host populated from the same actionForQuest mapping as the Quest card; clear it on no-focus/offline states.
Keep one canonical action mapping; no duplicate/hard-coded second resource mapping is introduced.
No notification ack, Quest mutation, reward, progression, achievement, or Neon write occurs in this slice.
All behavior changes are versioned and reversible from Git; event history is untouched.

capability_probes.assertion: The focused Status panel renders the same lesson-2 execution action/URL as the expanded Quest card.
REWARD, ACHIEVEMENT, and SUCCESS pushes deep-link to the exact notification and request full-screen celebration mode.
Ordinary info/warning notifications still open the Notifications view without forced celebration.
Opening a push/celebration does not acknowledge the notification or mutate player state.
A stale execution-action button is removed if focus disappears or the PWA becomes unavailable.
Quest scoring, reward issuance, streaks, Challenge pressure, shop, skills, achievements and push transport are unchanged.
Pre-change UI/navigation behavior remains recoverable from Git and immutable event history.

tests.expected: canonical action parity, celebration shell/behavior and script syntax PASS.
reward/achievement exact deep-links and ordinary info non-celebratory deep-link PASS.
full-screen dialog, focus action host, service-worker v22 and existing PWA contracts PASS.

known_intentional_losses: Reward/achievement/success push taps no longer land only on the generic notification list; they may immediately open a full-screen result dialog.
The Status focus panel gains a direct external execution link when a canonical action is known.

verification.candidate_readback: Candidate PWA, continuity, LifeUp and cloud lanes all passed after fixing the offline focus-action cleanup to use the existing harness-compatible DOM contract. Push payload tests prove exact reward/achievement deep links and ordinary-info non-celebratory routing; player utility tests compile-check the script and guard shared execution-action mapping plus celebration behavior.
verification.base_head_diff: Adds a full-screen result dialog, exact notification deep links for celebratory pushes, shared focused-quest execution action rendering, stale-action cleanup, cache v22, and regression tests. It changes no System ledger/player-state semantics and never auto-acknowledges notifications.
